# Seattle ProWash

> Roof cleaning, moss removal and gutter cleaning for homes in north Seattle and the Eastside. Based in Kenmore, WA and owner-operated by Dylan Thornsberry. Every roof cleaning includes moss treatment and gutter cleaning. Roof cleaning runs $850 to $1,200 for most homes; gutter cleaning starts at $350.

## Quick facts
- Business name: Seattle ProWash (Seattle ProWash LLC), www.seattleprowash.com
- Phone (call or text): 206-752-6690
- Email: seattleprowash@gmail.com
- Based in: Kenmore, WA 98028
- Google rating: 5.0 stars from 233 reviews
- WA contractor license SEATTPL783M6. Bonded and insured.
- Guarantee: 12 months moss-free after a roof cleaning
- Get a quote: fill out the form at https://www.seattleprowash.com/#contact or call or text 206-752-6690

## Pricing
- Standard roof cleaning: $850 to $1,200 (light to moderate moss). Includes moss removal, moss treatment, roof blow-off, gutter cleanout, downspout flushing and cleanup.
- Heavy moss removal: $1,200 to $2,000 (roofs heavily covered in moss). Same inclusions.
- Gutter cleaning only: starts at $350. Roof blow-off, gutter cleanout, downspout flushing and cleanup. Moss treatment not included.
- House soft washing, driveway and patio pressure washing, deck cleaning and exterior window cleaning are quoted by size and condition.
- Final price depends on roof size, pitch, moss buildup and access.

## Roofs we clean
Asphalt and composite shingles are most of our work. We also clean a lot of metal roofs (standing seam and corrugated). No high pressure on roofing.

## Cities we serve
Kenmore, Lake Forest Park, Bothell, Woodinville, Kirkland, Shoreline and north Seattle, plus Lynnwood, Mountlake Terrace, Edmonds, Mill Creek, Bellevue, Redmond and Sammamish.
